scenes.text: You need a toilet. So you make a bowl.
But how do you get rid of... this?
So you add an electric pump.
Press a button, and it sucks everything away.
Then you add a heated seat. A fan. Even lights.
Now nothing works. And it's just... sitting there.
So you get smart. You put a tank of water up high.
Pull the handle, and the water rushes into the bowl.
It fills higher than this bend in the pipe...
and gravity drags everything down. It's called a siphon.
No power needed. You just invented the flush toilet.
